say:1:1710704001:1.text: In a moment, please light the <style="highlight">Dreamweaver Lamp</style>.
say:1:1710704001:1.source_cn: 梅林，待会请帮我点燃那盏<style=highligh...
say:1:1710704001:1.male: In a moment, please light the <style="highlight">Dreamweaver Lamp</style>.
say:1:1710704001:1.female: In a moment, please light the <style="highlight">Dreamweaver Lamp</style>.

say:2:1710704002:1.text: The special incense inside will help me enter deep sleep.
say:2:1710704002:1.source_cn: 它里面的特制香料，能帮我尽快进入深度睡眠。
say:2:1710704002:1.male: The special incense inside will help me enter deep sleep.
say:2:1710704002:1.female: The special incense inside will help me enter deep sleep.

choice_prompt:3:1710704002.text: The special incense inside will help me enter deep sleep.
choice_prompt:3:1710704002.source_cn: 它里面的特制香料，能帮我尽快进入深度睡眠。
choice_prompt:3:1710704002.male: The special incense inside will help me enter deep sleep.
choice_prompt:3:1710704002.female: The special incense inside will help me enter deep sleep.

say:4:1710704003:1.text: On the contrary, Merlin. Right now, sleep is the swiftest path to action.
say:4:1710704003:1.source_cn: 正相反，梅林。对现在而言，入睡才是最快的行动方式。
say:4:1710704003:1.male: On the contrary, Merlin. Right now, sleep is the swiftest path to action.
say:4:1710704003:1.female: On the contrary, Merlin. Right now, sleep is the swiftest path to action.

say:5:1710704004:1.text: Heh. You wear the same doubtful look you did twenty years ago when I first explained it.
say:5:1710704004:1.source_cn: 你现在的表情和二十多年前第一次听说时，简直一模一样。
say:5:1710704004:1.male: Heh. You wear the same doubtful look you did twenty years ago when I first explained it.
say:5:1710704004:1.female: Heh. You wear the same doubtful look you did twenty years ago when I first explained it.

say:6:1710704005:1.text: The lamp's wick is made from a special feather, gifted by my teacher.
say:6:1710704005:1.source_cn: 织梦灯的烛心是由特殊的羽毛制成，而那羽毛来自于我的老师——
say:6:1710704005:1.male: The lamp's wick is made from a special feather, gifted by my teacher.
say:6:1710704005:1.female: The lamp's wick is made from a special feather, gifted by my teacher.

say:7:1710704006:1.text: She resides in a realm beyond ordinary reach.
say:7:1710704006:1.source_cn: 她存在于……常人无法触及的领域。
say:7:1710704006:1.male: She resides in a realm beyond ordinary reach.
say:7:1710704006:1.female: She resides in a realm beyond ordinary reach.

say:8:1710704007:1.text: She is a Celestial, named Aurora.
say:8:1710704007:1.source_cn: 她是一名半神，名为奥萝菈。
say:8:1710704007:1.male: She is a Celestial, named Aurora.
say:8:1710704007:1.female: She is a Celestial, named Aurora.

say:10:1710704008:1.text: Aurora? She took on a student?!
say:10:1710704008:1.source_cn: 奥萝菈？她也能给人当老师？！

say:11:1710704009:1.source_cn: 狐狸阁下……您果然，认识她。

say:12:1710704010:1.text: Ahem. Let's just say this fox has gotten familiar with a great many old books in his time.
say:12:1710704010:1.source_cn: 咳……算是吧，因为我是见多识广的传奇狐狸嘛，还曾经枕着...

choice_prompt:13:1710704010.text: Ahem. Let's just say this fox has gotten familiar with a great many old books in his time.
choice_prompt:13:1710704010.source_cn: 咳……算是吧，因为我是见多识广的传奇狐狸嘛，还曾经枕着圣堂的典籍睡过觉呢。

say:15:1710704012:1.text: Had I known, we might have summoned her by simpler means.
say:15:1710704012:1.source_cn: 如果早知道是这样，我们或许可以用别的办法呼唤她。
say:15:1710704012:1.male: Had I known, we might have summoned her by simpler means.
say:15:1710704012:1.female: Had I known, we might have summoned her by simpler means.

say:16:1710704013:1.text: Merlin, your lost memories continue to complicate matters.
say:16:1710704013:1.source_cn: 梅林，看来你的失忆确实造成了一些麻烦。
say:16:1710704013:1.male: Merlin, your lost memories continue to complicate matters.
say:16:1710704013:1.female: Merlin, your lost memories continue to complicate matters.

choice_prompt:17:1710704013.text: Merlin, your lost memories continue to complicate matters.
choice_prompt:17:1710704013.source_cn: 梅林，看来你的失忆确实造成了一些麻烦。
choice_prompt:17:1710704013.male: Merlin, your lost memories continue to complicate matters.
choice_prompt:17:1710704013.female: Merlin, your lost memories continue to complicate matters.

say:20:1710704017:1.text: In any case, what we must do now is ask Aurora for help.
say:20:1710704017:1.source_cn: 总之呢，我们现在要做的就是请求奥萝菈老师的帮助。

say:21:1710704018:1.text: She can manifest dreams, blurring the line between dreams and reality. She walks in the sleep of all beings.
say:21:1710704018:1.source_cn: 她能将梦境具象化，无论是将现实置于梦境，还是将梦境置于...

say:22:1710704019:1.text: With her power and this feather, we can walk in the dreams of that Mauler and uncover his secret.
say:22:1710704019:1.source_cn: 只有借助她的力量，我们才能凭借这根羽毛，潜入那个蛮血最...

say:23:1710704020:1.text: Merlin, I leave the next step to you.
say:23:1710704020:1.source_cn: 梅林，接下来，就拜托你了。
say:23:1710704020:1.male: Merlin, I leave the next step to you.
say:23:1710704020:1.female: Merlin, I leave the next step to you.

say:25:1710704015:1.text: It seems much has happened to you without my knowledge.
say:25:1710704015:1.source_cn: 在我不知道的情况下，看来你也发生了更多的事。
say:25:1710704015:1.male: It seems much has happened to you without my knowledge.
say:25:1710704015:1.female: It seems much has happened to you without my knowledge.

choice:17:1:2.text: It wouldn't be the first time...
choice:17:1:2.male: It wouldn't be the first time...
choice:17:1:2.female: It wouldn't be the first time...

choice:17:2:3.text: I wish my memories would return...
choice:17:2:3.source_cn: 哪一天能恢复记忆就好了
choice:17:2:3.male: I wish my memories would return...
choice:17:2:3.female: I wish my memories would return...

choice:13:0:1.text: Aurora lives with me in Avalon now.
choice:13:0:1.source_cn: 奥萝菈现在在我的阿瓦隆之地生活
choice:13:0:1.male: Aurora lives with me in Avalon now.
choice:13:0:1.female: Aurora lives with me in Avalon now.

choice:3:1:2.text: Is now really the time to rest?
choice:3:1:2.source_cn: 现在不是休息的时候吧？
choice:3:1:2.male: Is now really the time to rest?
choice:3:1:2.female: Is now really the time to rest?
